description: Adaptive high-resolution SHGO replication for the two p=1 QWOA cases whose initial 1024/2048-point searches disagreed

protocol.objective: expectation of cardinality + 13 * number of violated tasks
protocol.optimizer: SHGO Sobol sampling with exact-gradient L-BFGS-B local refinement
protocol.selection_rule: only cases failing the prespecified two-resolution p=1 convergence check
protocol.interpretation: replication audit, not a new performance-selected ensemble
